official_gazette.name: Federal Register (federalregister.gov API v1)
official_gazette.note: HTTP 200 verified JSON API; publishes federal rules, DOE/FERC notices, and weekly EPA EIS Notices of Availability, though state/local BESS siting permits are not published here.

environmental_assessment_portal.name: U.S. EPA Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) Database (+ BLM National NEPA Register)
environmental_assessment_portal.note: HTTP 200 verified; tracks federal EIS filings since 1987 (also https://eplanning.blm.gov/ HTTP 200 for BLM NEPA). State environmental reviews (CEQA, SEPA, MEPA) live on separate state portals.

open_data_portal.name: Data.gov
open_data_portal.note: HTTP 200 verified (535,196 datasets indexed); U.S. federal open data catalog.

geoportal.name: GeoPlatform.gov
geoportal.note: HTTP 200 verified; U.S. Federal Geospatial Data Platform.

latest_orthophoto.name: USGS NAIP Plus (The National Map)
latest_orthophoto.note: HTTP 200 verified (crdate-20250311); public-domain 6-inch to 1-meter CONUS orthoimagery (USDA NAIP + HRO).

cadastre.name: No single national private-parcel cadastre (decentralized across ~3,100+ counties; federal CadNSDI/PLSS & PAD-US standards)
cadastre.note: BLM CadNSDI (PLSS) and USGS PAD-US cover public/protected lands federally under FGDC standards, whereas private tax parcels for local BESS zoning reside in county assessor portals (usgs.gov PAD-US/cadastre URLs returned 403 CloudFront to curl).
